thread_title: S. alata var. atrorubra 'early red' Stone Co, MS
breadcrumb: S. alata var. atrorubra 'early red' Stone Co, MS

posts.body_html:
Here's another clone that is being evaluated, it didn't color up last season since it was selected out and transplanted that winter but almost 2 years later, it fully colored up this fall! These genetics aren't yet in circulation as this clone is still being evaluated. Intially, it was selected out for being able to color up all the way and coloring up earlier than others from the same population.

This clone almost (but not quite!) looks like a glorified S. alata 'Night' Stone Co, MS except so far, it's much easier to color up in comparison!
